name: Pieter Botha
bio:
Pieter Botha's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm outside Johannesburg. This early fascination evolved into a career dedicated to ensuring the smooth operation of racing teams. Before joining CLRT by Almeras, Pieter honed his skills coordinating logistics for smaller rally outfits, developing a reputation for meticulous planning and problem-solving under pressure.

Pieter's approach to logistics is deeply rooted in his commitment to precision. He believes that every component, from the smallest bolt to the largest transporter, must be accounted for and readily available. His methodical nature, coupled with an innate ability to anticipate potential challenges, allows him to keep the team one step ahead, minimizing delays and maximizing track time. He's not just moving parts; he's enabling performance.

physical.description: A man of sturdy build, Pieter carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool and a small notebook.
Insists on arranging transport crates in a specific order based on weight distribution.
Has a habit of double-checking manifests, even after they've been verified by others.
